theorem theorem_1_13
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    {X : Fin n → Ω → ℝ} (hXm : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam)
    (hXsub : ∀ i, definition_1_11 (X i) P lam)
    (hind : iIndepFun X P)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    P {ω | (1 / ↑n) * (∑ i, X i ω) > t} ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (exp (-(↑n / 2) * min (t ^ 2 / lam ^ 2) (t / lam))) ∧
    P {ω | (1 / ↑n) * (∑ i, X i ω) < -t} ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (exp (-(↑n / 2) * min (t ^ 2 / lam ^ 2) (t / lam))) := by
  sorry
